data.name: Focus Group
data.detailed_description:
FOCUS GROUP is a co-op puzzle adventure in the 1980s halls of Compliance Forge. You and your partner test prototypes under observation. Every room is a trial. Every success unlocks the next experiment.

  • Two player co-op: Every puzzle needs both players. You each get different tools or information and must work together to solve problems that neither of you could complete alone.

  • Communication is the key: When something goes wrong (and it will) you’ll need to stay calm, describe clearly, and think fast.

  • Story in a dystopian corporate world: Your only contact is Nora, your overly professional "personal coach." She's helpful. Maybe too helpful. And something about this place feels... wrong.

    Note: FOCUS GROUP is a co-op only game. It requires two players, each with an internet connection.

data.short_description: A co-op puzzle thriller set in the 1980s halls of Compliance Forge. You and your partner test unsafe prototypes. Talk, collaborate, and do whatever it takes to survive, and maybe get promoted.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD FX series or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 450 / AMD equivalent with 2GB+ of Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i5 4650 / AMD FX-8320 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 970/AMD 390 or equivalent with 3GB+ of Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Minimum:

  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia and AMD GPUs using Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver or AMD Vulkan drivers for the best experience. Also compatible with Mesa drivers.
